dct_title_s: Mandchourie et Corée : de Kharbine à Séoul de Port-Arthur à Vladivostok

[Inset map 1]. Environs de Vladivostok -- [Inset map 2]. Environs de Port Arthur : presqu'ile de Kouan-Toung
French map of Korea and Manchuria at the outset of the Russo-Japanese War of 1904. The title notes that the ma is translated from a Russian General STaff map of the region, published in Harbin.
